title: p2y5.4: Rust gateway: Yggdrasil tun backhaul integration
description: Integrate Yggdrasil as the primary backhaul. Open the Yggdrasil tun interface, read/write IPv6 packets. Gateway's 02xx:: address is its Yggdrasil address. Mesh nodes with 02xx:: addresses are reachable globally via Yggdrasil. This is the simplest backhaul — no prefix delegation, no NAT.
